entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie... I'm calling because I need to return an item. I'm just so disappointed, I really am.
I'm really sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, order number VF78901. It's for the Aero Race jersey. I've been a loyal customer for years and I saved up for this one.
Okay Sarah, thank you. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the jersey was delivered about 40 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it?
Well, it's the wrong size. I honestly feel terrible about it, but it's just way too tight in the shoulders. I can't even move properly in it. I was so excited, and now I just feel... stuck.
I understand, having gear that fits perfectly is essential. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for that item. One moment.
Okay... I just really needed this money back if I can't use it. It's a lot for a jersey.

Alright, I've checked for you. Since you're within our 90-day return window, we can absolutely get this sorted out. No problem at all. Would you prefer a full refund, or would you like to exchange it for a different size?
Oh, really? That's... wow, that's such a relief. Thank you! I was so worried. Yes, I'd love to do an exchange for the next size up, please.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I have initiated the exchange for you. I'm sending an email to you right now with a prepaid return label. Just pack up the current jersey, attach that label, and drop it off. As soon as the carrier scans it, we'll get the new one sent out to you.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really turned my day around.
You are very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful rest of your day, and enjoy the new jersey when it arrives!
